    About this map

    3,734 project records, including proposed and unsuccessful applications. These are not all existing solar farms. Select Operational only for records marked as operating.

    Source: DESNZ REPD, July 2026 (Open Government Licence), combined with Wilfred et al. research data (July 2025 file; paper published 2026). Research-only status information may be older.

    1,297 locations use points within mapped panel footprints. Other locations use government grid references. Positions are indicative; separate applications or phases may refer to the same farm. Eight possible overlaps are flagged. Rooftop, floating and mixed ground/roof REPD records are excluded.

    Snapshot compiled 29 September 2026. No live updates. Download retains all original attributes and source notes.

    Place search: Open-Meteo / GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). Postcodes: Postcodes.io. Search queries go to the selected provider only when you press Find. “My location” requests your browser’s permission.
